meta.title: Agent teams
meta.description: Lets the agent you talk to split a job among named teammates: it puts the work on a shared task board, waits for their results, and reports back; click Agent team next to the conversation title to see the members and tasks. Teammates edit the same files, and overlapping write scopes only show a warning. Each teammate makes its own model requests, so a team uses more tokens than one agent, and while the plugin is on, agents delegate through the team instead of the ordinary subagent tools.
